title: mdaa_bench: simulation bench for blind identification of latent dynamical structure (MDAA)

creators.name: Bonomo, Hudson A. R.
creators.affiliation: TMU-LAB — The Machine Unconscious Lab, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

description:
This version adds the fourth bench to the repository: the adaptive policy bench, supplementary material for Paper 6 (Adaptive Policy Learning in Situated Learning Accessibility).

What is new. Five planted worlds (S, N, K, V, R) test whether a reader that adjusts a declared window under the rule of layer 6 separates from readers that each drop one rule of that paper. R_declared calls the @tmulab/mdaa plugin by subprocess with layer 6. R_fixed is the same plugin with a range of zero width, which is the window of Paper 5. R_simple drops replication, R_mix drops provenance, R_sym also shortens on contradiction, and R_cross counts across vocabulary regimes.

Pre-registration and amendments. The pre-registration (adaptive/PREREGISTRO_v1.md) was frozen at commit bed380b, with SHA-256 hashes, line endings normalized to LF, verified by a guardian test (tests/test_adaptive_guardian.py). Three rounds of amendment (v0.3 to v0.5) were committed before the freeze, none from a result. A pilot on discarded seeds 901–905 (commit 65f5e6b) recorded only the control sides of the predictions and required no amendment.

Grid. 400 runs (20 cells × 20 seeds), with the authorization and the results committed at 3cd0aad. Six of the eight pre-registered predictions are met. P1 fails in one cell (S, T = 320, k = 5: 0.80 against a threshold of 0.90), which the pre-registration classifies as against the paper. P5 fails on its control side in one cell (K, T = 320, k = 3: R_sym 0.65 against 0.80), which it classifies as a defect of instrument. Results in adaptive/resultados/grid_adaptive_decision.json and grid_adaptive_rows.csv.

Measured plugin. The grid ran against three compiled files of tmulab-mdaa at commit 04e71bb (dist/adjustment-cli.js, dist/adjustment.js, dist/standing.js), whose hashes are fixed in adaptive/plugin.sha256; the pilot and the grid refuse to run against any other build. The plugin repository is private. These three files and the source of layer 6 are deposited as supplementary material with Paper 6.
